question: Multiplying both the numerator and denominator of the algebraic fraction \(3/(2x)\) by 4 gives \(12/(mx)\). What is \(m\)?
solution: Multiplying the denominator \(2x\) by 4 gives \(8x\), so \(m=8\). (The numerator also matches: \(3\times4=12\).)
